question: Estimate the GPUs (compute) required to run a national AI service like 'India ChatGPT' (Bhashini-scale) for 100M users.
idealClarificationQuestions: 100M MAU using a generative AI service like a national LLM? Yes.
Average usage: a few queries/day per active user? Assume 5 queries per day per active user.
GPU count for inference (training separate)? Inference.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total token volume per day / per-GPU throughput.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: But peak hour load is ~3-4x average: need ~75-100 GPUs for peak.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Per H100 GPU throughput for ~70B model inference
But peak hour load is ~3-4x average
If model is larger (200B+ India multilingual model)

calculationFlow: Per H100 GPU throughput for ~70B model inference: ~50K tokens/sec sustained = ~4.3B tokens/day.
If model is larger (200B+ India multilingual model): 3x more = ~900-1,000 GPUs.
